name: How far in advance should I plan for a major construction project with Hometelligent?
description: Plan 3-6 months in advance for major construction to allow for design, permits, and material procurement, especially in areas with long permit times.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I plan for a major construction project with Hometelligent?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a major construction project, we recommend planning at least 3-6 months in advance, especially for larger undertakings like custom homes or significant additions. This timeframe allows for essential preparation steps such as detailed design finalization, securing necessary permits, and ordering long-lead time materials. Early planning is particularly vital in our service areas like San Francisco or Walnut Creek, where permit application processing times can be extensive, ensuring all prerequisites are met before breaking ground.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan 3-6 months in advance for major construction to allow for design, permits, and material procurement, especially in areas with long permit times.
